decision: Internal development candidate only. Keep the location-test imagery sealed until the multi-seed rule is frozen.

model.context_scene_features: mean/max fused bottleneck plus mean/max/min centered MBMP
model.scene_score: sigmoid(0.35 * (0.85 * mean(top 1% observable mask logits) + 0.15 * max(observable mask logits)) + 0.65 * context logit)

training.augmentation: random right-angle rotations and horizontal/vertical flips
training.objective: positive-pixel BCE + top-2%-negative BCE + 0.5 positive soft-Dice + 0.5 BCE on fixed mask/context-fused scene logit
